methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked. A bodyless GET -> req.json() rejects -> caught -> null -> 400 'messages array required' (after auth). Other methods with a JSON body behave like POST.

request.parse: await req.json().catch(() => null) (intake.ts:14) — malformed JSON is NOT a 500 here; it becomes 400 'messages array required'.

fields.name: messages
fields.bounds: >= 1 message; total TEXT chars (string contents + text blocks' text) <= 30000 (MAX_TRANSCRIPT_CHARS); binary data not counted and not size-checked
fields.validation: non-array or empty -> 400 'messages array required'. Every message: role user|assistant; content string, or array whose every block is {type:'text', text:string} | {type:'image', data:string, media_type in image/jpeg|png|gif|webp} | {type:'document', data:string}; else 400 'malformed message'. Text total > 30000 -> 400 'Conversation too long — draft with what you have'.

fields.name: brief
fields.bounds: topic 1..300, audience 1..300, numSlides int >= 1 (no max), keyMessages 1..6 items each 1..300, context 1..4000, ready boolean
fields.validation: sanitizeBrief: per-field zod safeParse, invalid fields silently dropped, unknown keys dropped; never errors

fields.name: intakeSessionKey
fields.validation: if truthy, the transcript is upserted (fire-and-forget)

request.unknownFields: Ignored (top-level and inside brief). Unknown keys on messages are not forwarded (toAnthropicContent maps only known fields, _shared/intake.ts:20-27).

bodyShape.brief: Partial<IntakeBrief> — ONLY the fields changed this turn (sanitized), {} if none

responses.when: >= 12 assistant messages in transcript (no model call)

example.message: We've covered a lot — let's draft with what we have. Hit “Draft storyline” whenever you're ready.

responses.when: no user message in transcript (no model call)

example.message: Tell me about the deck you need — what's it for?

responses.when: model returned no text even after the follow-up call

example.message: Noted — anything else before we draft?

errors.when: malformed JSON, null body, messages missing/non-array/empty
bad role, bad content or block

body.error: Conversation too long — draft with what you have

errors.when: Anthropic API error (first call), missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (requireEnv throws plain Error)

sideEffects: If intakeSessionKey truthy: upsert intake_transcripts {user_id, session_key, messages (binary stripped to '[attachment]'), brief (sanitized, {} default), turn_count (user messages), total_chars, updated_at} on (user_id, session_key) — not awaited, errors logged (intake.ts:44-66; _shared/db.ts:368-389)
externalCalls: Anthropic messages.create, model STORYLINE_MODEL (default claude-sonnet-4-6), max_tokens 1024, tool update_brief; plus a second text-only call (max_tokens 512) when the first returns no text — PAID (_shared/intake.ts:105-122)
quirks: The response is plain JSON, NOT SSE — but the frontend's primary path streamIntake (src/lib/api.ts:81-139) expects text/event-stream frames. It parses the JSON body as one frame with no `type`, never sees `done`, throws 'Stream ended unexpectedly', and IntakeChat falls back to postIntake (src/pages/IntakeChat.tsx:96-104). Net effect: every intake turn hits /api/intake TWICE (two paid Claude calls, two transcript upserts). openapi.yaml, postman and api.md all describe an SSE response that the handler does not produce.
No per-user daily cap (comment intake.ts:7-10; reserveIntakeTurn exists in db.ts:171-175 but is unused); the only bound is 30000 text chars and 12 assistant turns.
Returned brief contains only fields changed this turn; client merges.
Leading assistant messages are stripped before calling the model (_shared/intake.ts:95-103).
Attachment bytes are not size-checked server-side; 'document' blocks are always sent as application/pdf.
beforeAnyState: Stateless; transcript upsert creates a row on first call.

tests.asserts: 200 {message, brief} with sanitized inbound brief; 400 for {}, [], role 'system', content 42; 400 oversize without model call; 401 (lines 29-58)

callers.where: src/lib/api.ts:81-139 (streamIntake, expects SSE) then fallback src/lib/api.ts:63-69 (postIntake, expects JSON {message, brief}); src/pages/IntakeChat.tsx:77-104

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:1606-1707 — WRONG response: documents 200 text/event-stream with delta/brief/done/error events; handler returns application/json {message, brief}. intakeSessionKey undocumented. 400 errors undocumented.
docs.postman: '3.1 Send intake message' description says 'Response is Server-Sent Events (SSE)' — wrong; bodies otherwise valid.

planSection65: Row '{messages[], brief?, intakeSessionKey?} → turn JSON' — accurate (turn JSON = {message, brief}). The frontend's SSE-first double call should be flagged: if the new service implements SSE the frontend would start using it; if it keeps JSON the double call persists.
